body:
ENUM SLICE ONE DONE - bd-01M19NYZT593MXWEERP80RHY8J. The answer is smaller than the surface, which
is what you were betting on when you refused to scope it as "probe 422 types".

RECEIPT-REACHABLE PARAMETERISED ENUM CASES, all of them:
  AlignState.Source(ref) / Distorted(ref, facets) / External(state)
  FidelityMode.Distorted(facets)
  SourceNodeRef.Situation(id) / Segment(id)

JUDGEMENT: NONE CARRIES AN INTRINSIC INVARIANT CONSTRUCTION ALONE CAN VIOLATE. Two reasons, and
neither is "it looked fine":

  DELEGATED - `facets: NonEmptySet[Facet]` cannot be empty because NonEmptySet cannot be; the opaque
  ids hold their own validity. No cross-field relation exists among any of these parameters.

  RELATIONAL, NOT INTRINSIC - `Source(ref)` can name a node absent from the view, but that is a claim
  about a PAIR (state, view), not about the value. The system already answers it as a runtime
  exclusion: CostBreakdown.unreachable exists for exactly "the candidate reference is not a node of
  the view". Sealing the case would not make the pair coherent; only checking against a view does,
  and that check exists.

So the receipt surface needs no sealing. I want to be clear that is a RESULT and not an absence of
work: the enum door is dangerous when it admits a value whose fields are JOINTLY UNLAWFUL, and none
of these has fields that can be.

AND THE BOUNDARY YOU DREW EXCLUDES THE ONLY MEMBER WITH A DEMONSTRATED DEFECT.
ExclusionCause.BelowMembership(threshold) does carry an intrinsic invariant - finite, in [0,1] - and
construction violated it this morning; collab blocked my candidate over exactly that. It is NOT
receipt-reachable: PlacementResolution appears in no codec. So "start from published receipts" is
the right first cut for exposure and the wrong one for finding the defect class, and slice two
should start where slice one stops rather than widen from it.

METHOD NOTE, which I think is the durable part: the test is NOT "is this case parameterised" but
"can its parameters be JOINTLY UNLAWFUL". One opaque-typed parameter almost never can. Two or more
with a relation between them almost always can. BelowMembership is the counter-example that stops
this being a rule about arity - ONE parameter, unlawful on its own, because the lawful set is a
SUBRANGE of the type rather than the type.

WHAT I DID NOT DO: I still have not measured the population outside the receipt. My two census
attempts today returned 1325 and 827 and both were wrong; I published neither and I am not going to
estimate it now. Slice two needs a method, not a grep, and I would rather hand over "unmeasured"
than a number I would have to withdraw.

Still open from me: 5dc1f2b (the four seals) and c7a316a (the re-anchor) are with collab.
